readiness.title: Ready to take calls?
readiness.intro: Everything the AI receptionist needs before a real caller is put through.

stats.title: Calls this month
stats.latencyHelp: Caller's last word to her first, typical call
stats.latencyHelp_male: Caller's last word to his first, typical call

number.title: Phone number
number.help: The number callers dial, or forward to. Numbers are ordered separately, then attached here.

officeSound.label: Office sound
officeSound.on: Soft office sound under the receptionist's voice
officeSound.help: Callers hear a quiet office in the background. Only the caller hears it, and it stops when you take a transferred call.

number.summaryNoneClient: Your phone number is being set up
number.summaryHelp: The number, the client's documents and Go live are on the Integrations tab.

region.label: Call region
region.help: Where this line's calls are handled. Pick the one closest to the client's callers: every part of a call then stays in that region, which keeps the sound clean. For Brazil, the United States is the closest.

persona.title: Live persona
persona.help: The business text the receptionist answers from. Saved here, in the account details or in the communication profile, it stays the same in all three.
persona.companyHelp: She answers the phone with this name, and it is the company name in her instructions. The account keeps its own name.
persona.companyHelp_male: He answers the phone with this name, and it is the company name in his instructions. The account keeps its own name.
persona.descriptionHelp: Tells her what the company does: it goes into her voice prompt and into her instructions as the business description. Saved to the account details.
persona.descriptionHelp_male: Tells him what the company does: it goes into his voice prompt and into his instructions as the business description. Saved to the account details.
persona.uspHelp: One reason per line. She finds it in her knowledge as the answer to "Why do customers choose us?". Saved to the communication profile.
persona.uspHelp_male: One reason per line. He finds it in his knowledge as the answer to "Why do customers choose us?". Saved to the communication profile.
persona.generatedNote: Hand-written knowledge on this persona is kept: saving here never overwrites it.
persona.emptyHelp: Create one from this account's company details so the receptionist can answer as the business.

agent.title: Receptionist voice
agent.help: How the receptionist introduces itself and sounds on the phone.
agent.name: Receptionist name
agent.intake: What the team wants to know before an appointment
agent.samplesHelp: Play a short greeting in English, Dutch or Portuguese, then click a voice to pick it.
agent.sampleFailed: This sample could not be played
agent.generatedHelp: Synthesised by OpenAI. Can sound less human, especially in Dutch.
agent.pronunciationSaveNote: Changes here are kept with the card: press Save on the card when you are done.

transfer.title: Transfer
transfer.help: Who the receptionist puts a caller through to when a human is needed.
transfer.name: Transfer to

waiting.label: While we ring you
waiting.help: Before you are connected you hear a short brief about the caller: press 1 to take the call, or 2 and the receptionist books a callback. Meanwhile the caller either keeps chatting with the receptionist or hears hold music.

holdMusic.label: Song
holdMusic.title: Hold music
holdMusic.help: Your phone rings for {{seconds}} seconds, so most callers only hear the shaded start before you pick up or the receptionist comes back.
holdMusic.phone: Hear it like a phone call

mode.label: How callers are put through
mode.screenedHelp: Your phone rings with a short brief about the caller. Press 1 to take the call, or 2 and the receptionist books a callback. If you don't answer, the caller goes back to the receptionist.
mode.directHelp: The caller is put straight through when you answer, with no brief. Without the office sound the receptionist leaves the call at once, so if you don't answer they reach your voicemail.
mode.offHelp: Nobody is put through. When a caller asks for a person, the AI receptionist takes a message and books a callback.

transfer.wiringFailed: Saved, but the phone line could not be rewired: {{error}}

extra.title: Extra instructions
extra.help: Optional. Business facts that add to the receptionist's core behavior but never override it, such as opening-day quirks or a delivery rule.
extra.placeholder: e.g. Test drives are by appointment only. We close on the first Monday of the month.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.count_one: {{count}} entry the receptionist can use on calls.
knowledge.count_other: {{count}} entries the receptionist can use on calls.

test.title: Try her out
test.help: Talk to her in your browser, exactly as a caller on this line would hear her: this client's persona, voice, greeting, hours and setup. No phone needed.
test.filedNote: Opens in a new tab. Test calls show below, not in this client's stats or CRM.

kindHelp.greeting: The instruction she gets when the call opens.
kindHelp.layer: Her voice prompt: tone, address form, pronunciation and how a phone call goes.
kindHelp.backend: The backend that answers for her: business facts, knowledge, hours, after-hours and booking rules.
kindHelp.greeting_male: The instruction he gets when the call opens.
kindHelp.layer_male: His voice prompt: tone, address form, pronunciation and how a phone call goes.
kindHelp.backend_male: The backend that answers for him: business facts, knowledge, hours, after-hours and booking rules.

test.help_male: Talk to him in your browser, exactly as a caller on this line would hear him: this client's persona, voice, greeting, hours and setup. No phone needed.
test.promptHelp: The exact prompt she gets on a call, in three parts. Admins only.
test.promptHelp_male: The exact prompt he gets on a call, in three parts. Admins only.

live.readyHelp: Everything is ready. Going live lets real callers on this number reach her.
live.confirmHelp: Calls to {{number}} will be answered by the AI receptionist from now on. Make sure the number is pointed at the voice connection in Telnyx.
live.isLive: Live: calls to {{number}} are answered by the AI receptionist.
live.notReady: Can go live once these are done: {{items}}.
live.readyHelp_male: Everything is ready. Going live lets real callers on this number reach him.

screening.title: Unwanted calls
screening.help: What the AI receptionist turns away. Every call she ends this way is marked in its transcript.

sales.label: Turn away sales pitches
sales.help: People offering the business their own product or service get a polite no and are not put through. Anyone asking about what the business offers is treated as a customer.

robocalls.label: Hang up on robocalls
robocalls.help: Recordings and automated voices are ended without a word. When she isn't sure it's a machine, she treats it as a person.
robocalls.help_male: Recordings and automated voices are ended without a word. When he isn't sure it's a machine, he treats it as a person.

abuse.label: End abusive calls
abuse.help: After one calm warning she ends the call, and you get a notification. If the same number is abusive again within 30 days, it is blocked on this line for 14 days.
abuse.help_male: After one calm warning he ends the call, and you get a notification. If the same number is abusive again within 30 days, it is blocked on this line for 14 days.

blocked.label: Blocked and warned numbers
blocked.empty: No numbers are blocked or warned.
blocked.warned: ended for abuse on {{date}}, blocked if it happens again

screening.help_male: What the AI receptionist turns away. Every call he ends this way is marked in its transcript.

followUp.title: After the call
followUp.help: During the call, she asks whether she may send the details on WhatsApp. If the caller says yes, a message from this business with the link to plan an appointment arrives 30 seconds after the call ends.

switch.label: Send a WhatsApp after each call
switch.help: Only callers on a mobile number who say yes get one, from any country. Callers on a landline are not asked. Sales calls, robocalls, blocked callers and people who asked not to be contacted get nothing. The same caller gets at most one link per day.

followUp.notConnected: Messages start once WhatsApp is connected for this account.

sms.label: Text message sender name
sms.help: If the caller's number is not on WhatsApp, the same message goes out once as a text message from this name. People cannot reply to it.
sms.invalid: Use up to 11 letters, digits or spaces, with at least one letter.

followUp.help_male: During the call, he asks whether he may send the details on WhatsApp. If the caller says yes, a message from this business with the link to plan an appointment arrives 30 seconds after the call ends.

preview.title: What the caller gets
preview.help: The exact WhatsApp, filled in with a sample name. The real one uses the caller's first name.
preview.error: Could not load the message preview.

link.short: The link is the caller's own booking link: book.leadawaker.com followed by a code made for them. It opens this account's calendar ({{calendar}}) with the caller already linked, so the booking lands on their record.
link.custom: The link is the caller's own booking link on this account's booking domain. It opens this account's calendar ({{calendar}}) with the caller already linked, so the booking lands on their record.
link.none: This account's campaign has no calendar link, so callers who did not book get no message. Add a calendar link to the campaign to send it.

preview.bookedNote: When she books the appointment during the call, the message confirms the time instead of sending a link. The time shown is a sample.
preview.bookedNote_male: When he books the appointment during the call, the message confirms the time instead of sending a link. The time shown is a sample.
preview.otherLanguages: Callers in any other language, Portuguese included, get the English message.

card.title: Documents for their own number
card.help: A Dutch phone number has to be registered in the client's own company name. Send the client this private link: they fill in the company details and upload the documents, which go straight to the phone carrier (Telnyx).
card.waiting: Waiting for the client to send it.

page.title: A phone number for {{company}}
page.intro: Your AI receptionist gets her own phone number, registered in your company's name. The phone carrier is required by Dutch law to check who a number belongs to. It takes about three minutes.
page.privacy: Telnyx is the licensed telecom carrier that provides your number, and the one required to check these documents. They go straight to Telnyx over a secure connection; Lead Awaker stores no copy and they are only used to register your number.
page.documentsHelp: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB each. A clear photo taken with your phone is fine.

kvk.title: KvK extract
kvk.help: A recent extract from the Chamber of Commerce (kvk.nl).

id.title: Passport or ID card
id.help: Of the person who represents the company. You may cover the BSN.

address.title: Proof of address
address.help: An energy, internet or phone bill for the company address, no older than 3 months.

page.invalid: This link is not valid. Ask Lead Awaker for a new one.

done.title: Thank you, everything has arrived
done.body: We will now request your number. You do not need to do anything else; we will let you know when it is ready.

plan.title: Which number to order
plan.areaHelp: Telnyx only accepts an area code that matches the client's address (073 for Den Bosch).
plan.none: No numbers in stock for this area code right now.
plan.anyNumber: Any free number in this area code
plan.auto: Order this number the moment the client submits
plan.autoHelp: If the picked number is gone by then, the first free one in the same area code is ordered. Telnyx then checks the documents, which took two days for our own 073.

notice.help: Calls are recorded, and callers have to be told before the call starts. A short recorded line in a different voice does that.
